statements.label: supported

statements.label: supported

statements.label: not_addressed

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Transcription factors expressed differently between the two species account for about 37% of the trans differences.
statements.evidence: We further identify differentially expressed transcription factors that underlie ∼37% of trans differences
statements.note: The abstract attributes roughly 37% of the trans differences to differentially expressed transcription factors.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Most regulatory elements that differed between human and macaque carried both cis and trans changes.
statements.evidence: Overall, we find that most divergent elements (67%) experienced changes in both cis and trans
statements.note: The abstract reports that most divergent elements (67%) had changes in both cis and trans.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Besides thousands of cis changes, the study uncovered an unexpected number of trans changes, roughly 10,000.

statements.label: supported

statements.label: supported

statements.label: supported

statements.label: supported

statements.label: supported
